item.title: City supports licence application of cannabis store seeking to relocate
item.description: The City of Fort St. John has voted to support an application by Cannabis Corner to the Liquor and Cannabis Regulation Branch for a licence at a new location.

item.title: Registration begins for annual dodgeball tourney in Fort St. John
item.description: Fort St. John's dodgeball tourney will feature awards for the top three teams and several categories on Saturday, March 7th, 2026.

item.title: Three foreign nationals arrested by extortion patrol are charged in B.C. shooting
item.description: SURREY — Police in Surrey, B.C., say three men arrested on Sunday by officers on an anti-extortion patrol are all foreign nationals and have been charged over gunfire at a home. item.title: City agrees to explore options around $20K support for youth mental health services
item.description: The City of Fort St. John council has voted to allocate $20,000 towards supporting Saplings Mental Health Services, pending the results of a staff report on the organization's future needs.

item.title: CER recommends approval of Westcoast’s pipeline expansion project
item.description: The Canada Energy Regulator (CER) found Westcoast Energy's Sunrise Expansion Program to be in the public interest.

item.title: First Nations clinic steps up as sponsor for masquerade ball
item.description: The Chetwynd and District Hospital Foundation's sponsors for the 2026 Masquerade Ball include the South Peace First Nations Primary Care Clinic, Tourmaline Oil and Canadian Natural Resources Limited.

item.title: Number of hours of northeast ER closures declines year-on-year in January, with Chetwynd ER shut twice
item.description: Northern Health reported two emergency room closures in northeast B.C. during January 2026, down from five in the same month in 2025.

item.title: Laundry, dishwashing, shorter showers: Fort St. John people asked to delay non-essential water use after leak discovery
item.description: Repairs to the feeder water main are set to begin on Thursday, February 5th and are expected to be completed within 48 hours.
